assumptions: Authorization is issue 2729 comment 5684812877: five independent compatible runner lanes for queue-sensitive jobs plus a stable aggregate required check; scope is runner lanes only.
Generation 2 is reserved for the parallel branch claude/2729-reroute-recovery; this contract is generation 3.
Lanes are free standard GitHub-hosted labels for this public repository; no larger or paid runners. No run is dispatched and branch protection is not changed.
goal: Add a declarative five-lane runner registry read by start-reroute qualified_lanes, a lane input for replacement runs of the queue-sensitive required checks, and a fail-closed stable aggregate check.
prohibited_actions: No database, migration, preview, production, claim or marker mutation.
No workflow_dispatch run, repository setting or branch protection change.
No edits to shared-supabase-migrations.yml, manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs, run-governed-review.mjs, orchestrator-snapshot.mjs, delivery-preflight or evidence-bundle.
No reviewer draw and no merge.
stop_conditions: Stop once the PR is open with a validated evidence pair and CI running.
Stop if fewer than five free compatible runner labels exist.
